readmeAndAttribution.suggestedPublicNotice: This is an unofficial Daoist Q-style UI and unit art package based on the functionality and unit definitions of Mindustry v160.7, by Anuken and the Mindustry contributors. Original project: https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry. Copied reference source files retain the upstream GPLv3 license at records/reference-ui-sources/LICENSE-Mindustry-v160.7. This repository contains artwork, UI previews and integration metadata, not a verified runnable Mindustry client or server.

recommendedFileSet.strategy: Use the exact accepted checksum allowlist plus its checksum file as the publication base. Preserve directory structure at repository root. Add only intentional publication README/notice/audit files in staging; rehash changed publication files without changing the existing accepted ZIP.
doNotInclude: any parent repository .git/config, credentials or unrelated project files
